hero.title: Engineering the Future, Together.
hero.body: Welcome to the Institution of Engineers Malaysia Student Section (IEMSS) at Universiti Tun Hussein Onn Malaysia. We bridge the gap between academic learning and professional excellence.

about.heading: Who we are
about.p1: At IEMSS-UTHM, we are more than just a student organisation; we are a launchpad for future innovators. Our mission is to cultivate a vibrant engineering culture on campus by giving students across mechanical, manufacturing and every other engineering discipline the tools, network and experiences they need to thrive in the modern industrial landscape.
about.p2: From technical design sprints to large-scale campus festivals, we empower students to step out of the classroom and into the real world of engineering.

membership.lede: IEM student membership connects you to the national body of engineers while you are still studying — talks, site visits, competitions and a professional record that starts before your first job.
membership.noteTitle: UTHM engineering students, local intake: you have already paid.
membership.noteBody: The RM50 IEM student subscription is bundled into your first-semester fees. You do not pay it a second time — just register and collect your card.
membership.costBody: For everyone else it is a one-off RM50, valid until you graduate. That single payment covers every IEMSS programme we run — site visits, workshops, talks, competitions — with no per-event fee. The equivalent technical events outside campus routinely charge hundreds to thousands of ringgit each.

benefits.title: Every programme, no extra fee
benefits.body: Workshops, competitions and site visits are free to members for the whole of your degree.

benefits.title: IEM journals and bulletins
benefits.body: Full digital access through your IEM member account.

benefits.title: A head start on graduate membership
benefits.body: Your student record carries over when you convert after graduation.

benefits.title: National-level competitions
benefits.body: Entry to IEM-run student competitions at branch and national level.

steps.title: Come to Membership Registration Day
steps.body: 17 October 2026, Dewan Kuliah A, G3. Or register online at myiem.org.my any time.

steps.title: Bring your matric card and student details
steps.body: Committee members verify your faculty and programme on the spot.

steps.title: Settle the subscription if it applies to you
steps.body: Local UTHM engineering students are already covered by first-semester fees.

steps.title: Collect your card at the IEMSS booth
steps.body: Check the collection status page before you come down.

faqs.a: Yes. Any UTHM student enrolled in an engineering or engineering technology programme is eligible.

faqs.q: I lost my card. What now?
faqs.a: Email iemssuthm@gmail.com with your membership number. Replacement takes about three weeks.
